title: Portion Control
metaDescription: Master portion control easily with measuring cups. Discover how simple tools can impact your eating habits and choices.
excerpt: Master portion control easily with measuring cups. Discover how simple tools can impact your eating habits and choices.
author: Devon RD
bodyHtml:
Portion control doesn’t have to feel restrictive – sometimes it’s as simple as grabbing your measuring cups and spoons. Using them to dish out meals and snacks takes the guesswork out of serving sizes and helps you stay consistent without relying on willpower alone. Over time, you’ll start to recognize what true portions look like, making mindful eating feel more natural. This small habit can make a big difference for anyone working toward weight loss, maintaining bariatric goals, or just wanting to feel more in control of their choices. Simple tools, big impact.

Nutrition and wellness have been at the heart of Devon’s career since graduating from Murray State University in 2009 with a degree in Nutrition and Dietetics. She has spent most of her career in bariatrics, specializing in helping individuals navigate sustainable, healthy change. Outside of work, she is a wife and mom of four who enjoys painting, reading, and getting lucky and baking the occasional perfect macaron.
